scope: Research-only institutional estimates vendor comparison. This is neither procurement authority nor a provider integration or selection.

estate_probe.method: Searched tracked engine/, scripts/, and config/ sources and inspected only environment-variable names for the candidate vendor names; no values were read or recorded.
estate_probe.interpretation: This establishes only that VEND-0 had no locally authorized sample or installed provider adapter at the probe time. It is not a statement about organization-wide subscriptions or a vendor's capability.

candidates.inclusion_reason: Primary LSEG materials identify analyst detail, consensus, aggregates, KPIs, global coverage, named history feeds, and a point-in-time package.

candidates.product: FactSet Estimates and FactSet Estimates Point-in-Time Consensus
candidates.inclusion_reason: Primary FactSet sources identify consensus and broker-detail estimate families, historical PIT consensus, fiscal-period request controls, and source-availability/last-modified fields in its API documentation.
Primary S&P materials describe estimates snapshots with effective/to-date fields, detailed current and historical estimates, revisions, broker/analyst coverage, and multi-channel delivery.

candidates.vendor: Visible Alpha, within S&P Global Market Intelligence offering
candidates.inclusion_reason: The combined S&P offering presents Visible Alpha as a distinct contributor-model/KPI dataset with different history and horizon claims; it must be separately entitled and sampled rather than assumed included in Capital IQ Estimates.

excluded_from_institutional_bakeoff.reason: Current-estate records identify snapshots/accrual but no licensed multi-horizon PIT estimate history; they remain the baseline, not a comparable institutional vendor.
Not admitted without primary evidence of the required PIT, correction, rights, and representative-record dimensions.

decision.reason: No authorized representative sample, field dictionary, contract-rights schedule, or reproducible as-of replay was available. Public product pages establish a credible candidate set but cannot prove usable record semantics or lawful rights.

required_external_gate: Obtain a procurement-neutral, time-limited evaluation entitlement or vendor-supplied redacted representative export for the frozen sample design, plus the applicable license/data-rights schedule. Do not contact vendors, start a trial, accept terms, purchase, or upload data under VEND-0 authority.
